prose: A global chip stock sell-off deepens after Broadcom's CEO likened AI investing to a casino, with Samsung down as much as 8.8%, SK Hynix 9.2% and Micron 4% (FT). Basis: the Techmeme headline and excerpt; the FT article was not readable.
